description: Parse a Specctra Design (.dsn) autorouter file exported from KiCad, Altium Designer, Cadence Allegro, or EasyEDA to extract coordinate resolution units, signal and power copper layer counts, and total netlist pin topology. Call this tool during pre-flight inspection when the hardware workflow uses Specctra .dsn exports instead of native .kicad_pcb files. Accepts raw dsn_text (UTF-8 Specctra S-expression string) or a local project_path. Returns JSON containing format ('specctra_dsn'), unit ('um' or 'mil'), resolution, layer_count, and net_count; verify net_count > 0 before invoking calligraphy_preflight_audit or calligraphy_route_pcb.

dsn_text.description: Raw UTF-8 Specctra .dsn S-expression text exported from an ECAD layout tool (starts with '(pcb ...'). Example: '(pcb design.dsn (parser ...) (resolution um 10) ...)'.

project_path.description: Local filesystem path to a Specctra .dsn file on the client machine (supported in local STDIO mode). Example: 'export/design.dsn'.

name: analyze_specctra_dsn
title: Analyze Specctra DSN Autorouter File
